note: The session's web-search allowance ran out after a few searches, so this part went mostly by fetching official pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py): county, city, court and school pages and the State Board of Elections' general recaps (2022 files named '<County> County.pdf', 2024 '<County>.pdf'), read with ballot/pdftext.py; totals are sums of the Total column over every precinct page carrying the contest. Image-only 2022 recaps (no text): Barren, Caldwell, Hopkins, Knox, Letcher, McCreary, Mason, Montgomery, Pike, Russell, Todd, Wayne. Not reached (host did not resolve): the Grayson, Boyle, Christian, Floyd, Knox, McCreary, Mason, Pike, Russell and Harrison county sites; Fort Thomas's site (certificate error, not bypassed). Not holders by the official pages read: Rocky Wright (Letcher County's page names Brian Slone as jailer), Yolanda M. Robinson (Christian County Schools' District 3 member is Lindsey Clark), Kyle N. Killebrew (Jefferson County Public Schools lists Gail Logan Strange for District 5 after the 2026 redistricting). Mary Anne Brown was not on Fort Thomas's 2024 council ballot; Steven J. Ayling was not on Shepherdsville's. No campaign site could be confirmed for Al Gentry or Lindsey Tichenor (www.algentry.com answered 403, so nothing was tied to it). Several here hold the office they seek (Durham, Wofford, Barnett, Castlen, Tackett, Henderson, Parrish, Morphew, Blau) while our record's incumbent flag is 0; the county clerks' lists do not mark local incumbents, so this is noted rather than filed as a review item.
